title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Job description:

Inbound Sales Executive - Building Technology Manchester Basic salary + profit share

Monday-Thursday, 8 am-4 pm Friday, 8 am-3 pm.

Enjoy selling, but would rather spend your time speaking to and qualifying interested customers than cold calling?

An innovative building technology company in Manchester is looking for an energetic Sales Executive to join its small, busy team.

Its products have been exceptionally well received, and strong demand has created this new position.

This is a fully inbound sales role: no cold calling and no prospecting.

But it is much more than taking orders. The business needs someone who can listen carefully, qualify inquiries, and follow opportunities through to a sale.

The role

You'll help customers turn their initial interest into a clearly specified project and an order. Responsibilities include:
- Responding to inbound inquiries and establishing what customers need.
- Handling pre-booked calls to understand projects, ask relevant questions and qualify opportunities.
- Learning how to qualify customer for technical projects, with full product training and support.
- Following up quotes, answering questions and keeping opportunities moving.
- Closing sales and ensuring the details are correct when orders are placed.

You do not need to be an engineer or arrive with specialist product knowledge.

You do need the curiosity and attention to detail to learn how the products fit each customer's project.

The person

This would suit a proactive salesperson who enjoys being on the phone, listens properly and knows how to turn a good inquiry into a sale.

The key qualities are:
- Strong sales aptitude, with the drive and confidence to qualify opportunities thoroughly and ask for the order when appropriate.
- Energy, initiative and a willingness to take ownership of inquiries.
- Excellent listening skills.
- An eye for detail when gathering information and pre-qualifying the customer for the team producing the quotes.
- An organised approach to follow-up in a busy sales environment.
- A practical, hands-on attitude and an enthusiasm for learning.

Experience in technical, specification-led or project-based sales such as kitchen or security design lead type sales would be useful, but it is not essential.

Applications are welcome from good salespeople in any sector who can demonstrate these qualities.

What's on offer
- Basic salary plus profit share. We've shown only the base salary in the advertisement.
- Full product training.
- An established flow of inbound inquiries-no cold calling.
- A friendly, energetic and hands-on working culture.
- A small team where your contribution will be visible.
- A newly created role driven by business growth.
- Working hours of 8 am-4 pm Monday to Thursday and 8 am-3 pm Friday.

To apply, send your CV with a short note outlining your sales experience and what makes you a good fit for an inbound, project-led sales role.

Benefits:
- Company pension
- Free parking
- On-site parking
- Profit sharing

Work Location: In person

title: Client Services Director
description:
Client Services Director

Manchester

About the Opportunity

Our client is a growing and ambitious accountancy and business advisory firm that places a strong emphasis on its people, culture, and long-term development. With a collaborative approach and a commitment to delivering exceptional client service, they offer a supportive environment where individuals are encouraged to develop their careers and make a meaningful impact.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established team in Manchester and play a key role in leading client relationships, developing people, and contributing to the continued growth of the business.

The Role

As Client Services Director, you will work closely with senior leadership and the accounts team to deliver high-quality advisory and compliance services across a diverse client portfolio. The role offers a blend of client-facing responsibilities, team leadership, and commercial involvement.

Key responsibilities include:
- Managing a varied portfolio of clients across multiple sectors.
- Building and maintaining strong, long-term client relationships and acting as a trusted advisor.
- Leading and developing a team, ensuring the delivery of high-quality work and exceptional client service.
- Working collaboratively with directors and colleagues across the wider business.
- Developing a deep understanding of clients' businesses to provide proactive advice and support.
- Identifying opportunities to expand existing client relationships and generate new business.
- Leading business development activity, including networking, proposals, presentations, and pitches.
- Overseeing larger and more complex assignments with support from the wider team.
- Driving efficiencies by reviewing processes and implementing improvements.
- Coaching, mentoring, and developing team members and direct reports.

About You

The successful candidate will be a commercially focused practice professional who enjoys building relationships, developing teams, and contributing to business growth.

This opportunity would suit either:

An experienced Senior Client Manager ready to move into a Director-level position.
An existing Director seeking a fresh challenge within a progressive and growing firm.

You will ideally possess:
- ACA or ACCA qualification.
- Previous experience operating at Senior Manager, Director, or equivalent level within accountancy practice.
- Experience working with a broad range of clients, including owner-managed businesses.
- Strong commercial awareness with a proven ability to identify and develop opportunities.
- A proactive approach to business development and client relationship management.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong leadership qualities, with experience developing and motivating teams.
- Confidence working within a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
- Experience using practice management and accounts software, with knowledge of CCH considered advantageous.

Benefits

Alongside a competitive salary package, our client offers a comprehensive benefits programme, including:
- Generous annual leave entitlement.
- Additional birthday leave.
- Holiday purchase scheme.
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements.
- Salary sacrifice car scheme.
- Structured learning and development opportunities.
- Company pension scheme.
- Private medical scheme via salary sacrifice.
- Access to health and wellbeing resources.
- Regular social, wellbeing, and community engagement initiatives.

About Our Client

Our client is a well-established and growing accountancy and business advisory group with a strong presence across the UK and Ireland. They work closely with a broad client base, supporting businesses through a combination of technical expertise, commercial insight, and relationship-led advice.

The firm has experienced significant growth in recent years and continues to invest in both its people and service offering. Their culture is built around collaboration, integrity, ambition, and delivering exceptional outcomes for clients.

They are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive working environment where individuals are empowered to develop their careers, contribute new ideas, and play an active role in the future success of the business.

If you're looking for an opportunity to combine client leadership, people development, and business growth within a forward-thinking practice, we'd be delighted to hear from you.

Are you ready to make a difference in the retail appliance industry? Our client is on the lookout for a dynamic and enthusiastic Outbound Customer Success Advisor to join their growing team at their head office in Salford! If you thrive in a high-volume call environment and enjoy helping customers succeed, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Do:
As a pivotal member of the team, your mission will be to connect with customers and enhance their experience with our client's Reward scheme. Here's what you can expect to do:
- Engage Customers: Reach out to customers who have onboarded but haven't yet claimed their rewards, guiding them through the claims process with care and clarity.
- Support Onboarding: Assist customers who faced challenges during onboarding, diagnosing issues and ensuring they complete the process smoothly.
- Customer Satisfaction Checks: Follow up with customers who have recently had products installed to gauge their satisfaction with the product and service.
- Issue Logging: Identify and log any concerns raised, escalating issues as needed to ensure prompt resolutions.
- Quote Progression: Contact customers who have requested quotes but haven't provided necessary information to move forward.
- Follow-Up: Reconnect with customers who haven't responded to previous requests for additional information.
- Remove Blockers: Work diligently to eliminate any obstacles in the quoting process, striving to convert more inquiries into booked and paid installations.
- Record Keeping: Maintain accurate records of all calls, outcomes and customer interactions in the CRM system.
- Feedback Loop: Collaborate closely with the Customer Service Manager to report common issues or trends.
- Brand Representation: Always represent the company professionally, reflecting brand values and building customer trust.

What We're Looking For:
To succeed in this role, you should possess the following qualities:
- Rapport Builder: An ability to connect quickly with customers and maintain a friendly telephone manner.
- Problem Solver: A keen mindset for identifying key issues and offering effective resolutions.
- Efficient Worker: An organised and conscientious approach to managing multiple call types throughout your day.
- Tech-Savvy: Basic IT literacy to effectively utilise CRM systems and tools.

Performance Measures:
Your success will be measured by:
- The number of successfully completed calls leading to customer onboarding.
- The number of quotes progressed to booked and paid.
- Call volume and quality against set targets.
- The number of 4- and 5-star customer reviews generated as a result of your outbound efforts.
